Question 2
?
Consider the first-order linear ODE dydx−y=2x−5. We wish to solve this equation using the method of variation of parameters (VOP).

Select the correct options below.

According to VOP, we assume a particular solution of the form
 
u(x)e5x
u(x)e−x
u(x)e−2x
u(x)e2x
u(x)ex
.

Solving for u, we have u(x)=
 
∫e−x(2x−5)dx
∫e−x(2x+5)dx
∫ex(2x−5)dx
∫e−x(5−2x)dx
.

Therefore, the particular solution is yp(x)=
 
e−x∫e−x(5−2x)dx
ex∫e−x(2x−5)dx
e−x∫ex(2x−5)dx
ex∫e−x(2x+5)dx
.
